svg.title: ArdaRenderGraph complete build, compile, and execute call chain
svg.desc: Source ordered call graph from public builder APIs through logical dependency discovery, compiler lowering, resource materialization, command recording, queue submission, extraction, and completion.
svg.text: ArdaRenderGraph: complete source ordered call chain
Public API to logical graph to compiler products to physical resources to NVRHI queue submission
Cyan: function call | Green: stored output | Amber dashed: validation, guard, or queue wait

g.text: 1 | BUILD - create logical records and discover incoming hazards
make_unique of FImpl; validate graphics queue
import map dedupe and initial state check
extraction sets flag and final state
automatically invoked by AddPass/CreateUniformBuffer; never user-callable
no graph-created GPU object exists yet
null check then automatic parameter snapshot
AddPass then setup callback then dispatch
render slots also build raster signature
incoming edges only; consumers come later
manual edge must be distinct and forward
manual producer edges also affect culling
null returns; require same registry object and state not Unknown
producer = order plus liveness; synchronization producer = order only
declared range remains in pass state
access order is metadata declaration order
cached? return; reject bad lifecycle; set mbCompiling; call FARDGCompiler::Compile; clear mbCompiling
2 | COMPILE - validate, cull, lower state, and publish executor metadata
HELPER CALL CHAIN AND INTERNAL LOGIC
all passes, including later culled work
flags; backing; state legality; bounds; UAV and attachment capability; queue legality
replay produced texture cells and whole buffers; check reads; publish writes
external resources start produced; same-pass write may initialize same-pass read
fatal check on any contract violation
For each external or extracted texture and buffer
last producer to Epilogue.AddProducer; trailing readers to AddSynchronizationProducer
data edges root observable output; trailing reads provide ordering only
P8 is appended after all user passes
final boundary and normal culling root
immediate mode and sentinels stay graphics
flag, compute queue, no graphics-only states
normalize shader resource state for async
one selected queue domain per pass
live handle use to execution index interval
ResetUsage then replay live pass texture and buffer states
external and extracted resources gain epilogue use; map pass handles to execution indices
transient only when Transient and not External or Extracted
extended lifetime or immediate mode widens every interval to the full graph
ordinary passes then epilogue final state
merge compatible reads; reject conflicting writes; emit before/after records
equal UAV requests ordering; conservative equal state requests a forced barrier
independent replay checks continuity, access satisfaction, and final states
transitions are still keyed by logical resource identity
11 | CompileAsyncMetadata: backward fork and forward join graph walks
13 | CompileRasterGroups assigns compatible consecutive raster runs
3 | EXECUTE - materialize, record, synchronize queues, submit, and publish outputs
reset execution result; copy immediate mode; guard marks mbFailed unless completed
consume order, lifetimes, transitions, pipelines, edges, and queue dependencies
culled passes are absent; execution is one shot
yes: create virtual probes; query memory requirements; transient allocator computes ideal layout
actual path uses committed fallback; pool key uses normalized descriptor and exact equality
reuse requires same queue domain and availableAfter less than firstUse
external keeps imported handle; cross-queue and non-transient domain is minus one
execution-local pools do not persist across graphs
state keyed by ITexture or IBuffer pointer
rewrite logical before states after reuse
runtime before from physical history; after from compiled logical requirement
recompute equal UAV ordering; keep forced barrier only while before equals after
mbClobberFirstWrites tracks first produced texture cells and whole buffers
plan supported depth, color, or UAV clears; copy passes skip clobber
this repairs state continuity when two logical lifetimes share one physical object
physical identity and corrected before state
level = max of producer level plus one
not immediate; option enabled; pass lacks NeverParallel
MaxWorkers from option or hardware concurrency; std::async per eligible pass
future.get joins a batch before the next batch or dependency level
this is CPU command encoding concurrency, not GPU submission order
one command list per live pass with work
CreateBindingSetForPass validates declared ownership and access
user lambda records dispatch, draw, or copy through the command list
mPassAccessMutex protects active access gates during parallel recording
dispatch; draw; copy from user callback
reject foreign, undeclared, or unbound access
sentinels never invoke a user callback
createCommandList Graphics; writeBuffer; ConstantBuffer state; executeCommandList
returns UploadInstance; graphics pass submission is naturally ordered after upload
first compute and copy consumer queue waits on the upload instance once
recording order does not establish GPU order; submission and waits do
one waited bit per non-graphics queue
uniform storage is now GPU initialized
skip no list; issue waits; execute list
store pass and per-queue instance IDs
For each queue dependency whose consumer is this pass
if producer instance is nonzero: queueWaitForCommandList on producer queue instance
same-queue edges rely on queue order; cross-queue edges use explicit waits
executeCommandList returns the instance used by later consumers
set mbExecuted; disarm guard; trace counters; return FARDGExecutionResult
